newsitem.title: USA: Advanced Medical sees Q4, year loss.
newsitem.headline: Advanced Medical sees Q4, year loss.

text.p: Advanced Medical Inc said that, as expected, it will take restructuring charges in the fourth quarter, which will cause it to report losses in both the fourth quarter and fiscal 1996.
The charges relate to the restructuring following the acquisition in November of IVAC Medical Systems and the ensuing integration of the two companies.
Advanced Medical said it has so far eliminated 125 jobs in the combined company and that "subsequent integration activities are continuing as planned."
The expects to report fourth quarter results on April 15.
